comingLast.roast: 20 off 28 - some days the shots just are not enough
he needs 4 points and a small miracle - the bar has odds on both
on 17 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
on 17 - his caddy (his mate with the beers) has gone quiet
on 19 with 5 to go - the blue balls can smell the clubhouse
in with a 3-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
safe by 4 - unless Bradley finds form, in which case, gulp
5 clear and finished - now a full-time Bradley supporter
finished 5 clear - the presentation can come whenever it likes now
